extensionDescription.message:
Identitiy Manager Plus makes managing and using your Thunderbird Account Identities a bit easier.

It displays a list of your Identities and allows you to choose the correct Identity when composing a new email, replying to one, or forwarding one.

And it allows you to decide in which order your Identities are listed.

Part of it is based on the Identity Chooser MX Extension.
